features: Eagle Eye Cloud Managed Video Recorder (CMVR): stores video locally and acts as a gateway to the Eagle Eye cloud
Video encrypted in transit and at rest
Supports ONVIF Profile S IP cameras
notes: Camera capacity is the datasheet's typical figure for 4 MP cameras.
Storage: 2025 datasheet gives 192 TB raw, 160 TB usable (RAID 6) and the hardware page gives 192 TB; 2023 datasheet gives 120 TB raw, 100 TB usable (RAID 6). The 2025 value is used.
2025 datasheet gives retention as 40 days for 165 cameras at 4 MP.
2023 datasheet gives LPR support as No; 2025 datasheet gives Yes. LPR support left out.
2023 datasheet gives video output as HDMI (1), VGA (1), DP (1); 2025 datasheet gives HDMI (2), DP (2). Video output left out.
2023 datasheet gives dimensions as 437 x 647 x 89 mm; 2025 datasheet gives 483 x 686 x 89 mm. Dimensions left out.
2023 datasheet gives maximum power consumption as 280 W; 2025 datasheet gives 800 W. Maximum power consumption left out.
